key.name: power
key.summary: Key to switch on power only

key.name: oled-shift
key.summary: Shift lock screen content (OLED burn-in protection)
key.description: While the screen stays on, glide the clock, date and notifications to a new random position every interval, like the Screen Shift feature of OLED TVs. The wallpaper is not moved.

key.name: oled-content-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the lock screen content (percent)
key.description: Shows the clock and notifications dimmer while the screen stays on, like the logo luminance adjustment of OLED TVs. 100 = unchanged.
